notes: int generator state: seed * 3877 + 29573 stays below 2^30, so no overflow; (double) seed / IM is a plain IEEE division.
Linear scan over a cumulative double[]; the tables are built from Acid records.
ALU lines are slices of the bytes of alu + alu[0..60), so a line never needs to wrap mid-copy.
Lines are built in a byte[61] and written to a 64 KiB BufferedOutputStream over FileDescriptor.out; default JVM flags.
